result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a stuck loading spinner overlaid on an already-loaded restaurant card.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck overlaid in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image under 'Popular right now', even though the image and card details have finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator or refresh spinner is properly dismissed and hidden once the image or page data finishes rendering.
